question: (i) Write the expression for the speed of electromagnetic waves in vacuum in terms of $\mu_0$ and $\varepsilon_0$. (ii) What is the significance of this value?

options.A: $c=\sqrt{\mu_0\varepsilon_0}\approx3.0\times10^{-8}\text{ m s}^{-1}$. This value shows light is a mechanical wave.
options.B: $c=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{\mu_0\varepsilon_0}}\approx3.0\times10^8\text{ m s}^{-1}$. This equals the speed of light in vacuum and shows that light is an electromagnetic wave.
options.C: $c=\dfrac{\mu_0}{\varepsilon_0}\approx1.4\times10^5\text{ m s}^{-1}$. It shows all waves need a medium.
options.D: $c=\dfrac{1}{\mu_0\varepsilon_0}\approx9.0\times10^{16}\text{ m s}^{-1}$. It shows light travels infinitely fast.
